summary: Status rows: every check, job, backup, service and machine that reports to Aico, problems first.

help:
Usage: st status [options]

Shows every check, job, backup, service, VM and machine that reports to Aico on this
machine: problems first (failed, late, unknown, warn), healthy rows folded into a count.

Options:
  --state S[,S]     failed, late, unknown, warn, ok, off
  --kind K[,K]      check, job, backup, service, vm, machine, link, grant, repo
  --machine M[,M]   only these machines
  --project P[,P]   only these projects
  --search TEXT     text in the name, meaning, id, machine or project
  --sort ORDER      problems (default), what, updated, next
  --all             list the healthy rows too
  --json            the API answer as JSON

Reads aico-web on loopback (GET /api/status). Rows are written by the programs that run
the work (POST /api/status/rows on loopback; Python: native/host-steward/aico_status.py).

usage.cmd: st status [--state S] [--kind K] [--machine M] [--project P] [--search TEXT] [--sort ORDER] [--all] [--json]
usage.when: see what is failed, late, unknown or warning across checks, jobs, backups, services and machines, and what to run about it
precautions: Read-only. Late and unknown are problems, never ok: unknown means the machine stopped reporting.
